acceptance_criteria.criterion: #10811 is rebased onto current origin/main and its three conflicts are resolved, with the floor-pin conflict resolved to main's side rather than to the PR's stale 227. Evidence: the rebase and the resolved hunk.

Both parts of the co-edit ship together: the tag floor is raised to the number the gate PRINTS (264 -> 266 as measured, re-derived not assumed) AND the coalesced_attempts allowlist row is deleted. Evidence: both diff hunks.
The census gate is GREEN on the rebased head: `cd cloud && CC=clang mix test test/barkpark_cloud/payload_key_set_census_test.exs` passes. Evidence: pasted tail output.

The other open PRs touching the same pins (#10129, #10086) are checked for collision and the merge order is stated, because both floors are == and all three touch client.go. Evidence: the stated order and the collision check.
MERGE-GATED (the LEAD closes this): merged to origin/main with main still green on the census gate afterwards. Evidence: the merge sha and a post-merge gate run.

content.description:
MEASURED BY MERGING IT LOCALLY ONTO origin/main IN A THROWAWAY CLONE AND RUNNING THE REAL GATE. #10811 does NOT merge: three conflicts, one of them INSIDE the floor-pin block itself — the PR's context lines are @emitted_floor 123 / @go_tag_floor 225->227 while main is at 144/264, so its stated floor of 227 is arithmetic against a tree 39 tags in the past and is not a value that can be applied. Charter :6804's 'so s6 inherits 227' is STALE and struck by D571.

Resolving the three conflicts to MAIN's side (the honest resolution — main's pin is the thing under test) and running the census gate on the auto-merged client.go gives: '266 json tag(s) found in internal/cloudclient, floor is EXACTLY 264' — delta +2, exactly the two new tag NAMES computed by set-difference beforehand: coalesced_attempts and since. AND A SECOND, UNDISCLOSED RED nobody had predicted: the UNREAD arm fires 'no longer unread (allowlisted but now decoded — DELETE the allowlist row): coalesced_attempts'. Total 23 tests, 2 failures.

SO THE MERGE ORDER IS A TWO-PART CO-EDIT, not a one-line floor bump: raise 264->266 AND delete the coalesced_attempts allowlist row.

FROZEN GREEN, PROVEN BY TIMESTAMP: #10811's last commit is 2026-08-08T11:35:31Z; the census test's floors last moved on main at 2026-08-09 21:50:42 (a9e70d52aa, #11424). Its recorded 25/25 green was earned against a tree whose pins no longer exist, and only a PUSH re-fires the verdict.

THIS REGRESSION IS TRACKED BY NO OTHER TASK. dr-w26-bl-10129-and-10086-red-mains-census-on-merge names only #10129 and #10086. Note both floors are `==` and #10811, #10129 and #10086 all touch internal/cloudclient/client.go, so the merges are NOT independent: whichever lands second must be re-measured from scratch, never summed.

tags.rationale: An open PR that reds main on merge, with measured numbers.
The regression is in internal/cloudclient's json tag census.
